title: Palindrome Number
description: Given an integer x, return true if x is a palindrome, and false otherwise.

steps.note: Check if x is non-negative and convert 1221 to array of digits.
Initialize left pointer i = 0 and right pointer j = 3.
Check while condition i (0) < j (3). Loop continues.
Compare s[i] (1) with s[j] (1). They are equal.
Move pointers: increment i to 1, decrement j to 2.
Check while condition i (1) < j (2). Loop continues.
Compare s[i] (2) with s[j] (2). They are equal.
Move pointers: increment i to 2, decrement j to 1.
Check while condition i (2) < j (1). Condition fails, loop ends.
All matching digits confirmed. Return true.
